title: A Homecoming for the Locker
author: Bram Dunmore
blurb: Noor Amberdale, a coder whose anonymous account knows too much, has spent three years being so careful it hurts. Then a best friend goes missing, leaving only a set of keys behind — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must decide who to be when the labels come off, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
